title: Synthetic Twins: Closing the Gap Between TTS Test Sets and Real Recordings in Turkish ASR Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30694v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech synthesized by text-to-speech engines is a low-cost substitute for recorded test sets in automatic speech recognition, yet an off-the-shelf synthetic test set is worth only a few dozen real recordings for estimating the real error rate of a recognizer. This paper examines which properties of real recordings are missing from synthetic speech and how much of the gap can be closed. For 507 Turkish Common Voice recordings, synthetic twins are built: a ladder of synthetic copies that adds, one factor at a time, the pitch of the speaker, a clone of the same speaker, the real recording channel and the speaking rate. At each step, the agreement between ASR behaviour on the copy and on the real recording is measured. Across three zero-shot cloning engines and panels of six and 19 recognizers, the speaker clone is the step that improves agreement on which sentences are hard, raising the Spearman correlation from .41 to .55 for Chatterbox. M

translated_title: 合成孪生：在土耳其语ASR评估中缩小TTS测试集与真实录音之间的差距
translated_abstract: 由文本转语音引擎合成的语音是自动语音识别中录音测试集的低成本替代品，但现成的合成测试集在估计识别器真实错误率方面的价值仅相当于几十条真实录音。本文研究了真实录音的哪些属性在合成语音中缺失，以及这一差距能被弥补多少。针对507条土耳其语Common Voice录音，研究者构建了“合成孪生”：一系列逐级添加因素的合成副本，每次添加一个因素——说话人的音高、同一说话人的克隆、真实录音声道以及语速。在每一步中，测量ASR在副本上与在真实录音上行为的一致性。在三个零样本克隆引擎以及6个和19个识别器组成的面板实验中，说话人克隆是改善“哪些句子难以识别”这一判断一致性的关键步骤，对Chatterbox而言，Spearman相关系数从.41提升到了.55。
tldr: 本文提出“合成孪生”方法，通过逐级向合成语音添加说话人音高、说话人克隆、真实录音声道和语速等因素，发现说话人克隆是缩小合成测试集与真实录音在土耳其语ASR评估差距的关键，将Spearman相关性从.41提升至.55。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "synthetic twins"—a ladder of synthetic copies that progressively adds speaker pitch, speaker cloning, real recording channel, and speaking rate—showing that speaker cloning is the key step to close the gap between TTS test sets and real recordings in Turkish ASR evaluation, raising the Spearman correlation from .41 to .55.
